messages:
Leah Morrison: Ok team  NimbusGrid co-showcase confirmed for Aug 16. Format: 30m keynote + 3x 20m breakout clinics (hands-on). Need clinic leads, sample-kit plan, QR-based swag claims (to reduce global shipping), and a short fallback clip.

Devon Park: I can coordinate clinic leads. Suggest breakout tracks: 1) Marketplace embed + CI, 2) Edge deployment patterns, 3) Integration templates for SIs.

Arjun Singh: I'll lead the Edge deployment clinic. Who's doing the marketplace embed clinic?

Devon Park: @Priya want the marketplace embed?

Priya Mehta: Happy to. I'll own the embed clinic and the partner-run templates. Need speaker bios (40-60 words) and handle info by 8/1.

Riley (events): Logistics note: want to avoid heavy worldwide swag shipping. Proposal: small sample-kit for local organizers + QR codes emailed to opt-in attendees to claim a digital merch pack (sticker PDF + e-gift card). Works?

Leah Morrison: Love QR-first approach. For region VIPs we can still ship physical kits. Riley, please add fields to registration for "digital swag" vs "physical kit (limited)". Physical winners get a sample-kit: RDW-CL-005 (USB with runbook, ethernet dongle, sticker sheet). Declared value $9.00.

CourierAI: Reminder: for physical shipments include HS codes and commercial invoice. Suggested hold policy: undelivered -> notify 7 days -> return to sender after 21 days.

Arjun Singh: For hands-on lab access we'll mint short-lived session tokens (TTL=12h). We should gate physical kit claims to attendees who completed the lab to avoid waste.

Devon Park: Agree. Registration flow: collect name, email, timezone, "claim kit" opt-in, and a checkbox confirming hands-on attendance. Riley: can you add that?

Riley (events): Yup. Also adding an optional phone field for couriers (opt-in). Legal confirmed we must purge addresses after 90 days.

Priya Mehta: Partner asked to reuse recording. We're fine as long as it's co-branded and includes an attribution line linking to Redwood docs. Add that to the partner agreement.

Leah Morrison: Fallback: need a 3-5min pre-recorded clip per clinic (so 3 clips). @Arjun can you do edge clip? @Devon + @Priya cover the others. Ask: preferred format MP4 720p, include short transcript.

Arjun Singh: I'll record 4-min MP4 and include .srt transcript. Will upload by 8/10.

Devon Park: Same from me. For the embed template clinic I'll include a tiny sandbox repo and a CLI snippet in the runbook. Add snippet to runbook:

```
# quickstart: embed widget
export REDWOOD_KEY=REDACTED
nimbus-widget init --model redwood-mini --site example.com
```

Priya Mehta: For the marketplace widget we should also provide a tiny iframe example to put on partners' pages. I'll prepare the marketplace card assets.

Riley (events): Swag distribution plan: digital QR codes go out immediately after event to attendees who opt-in. Physical kits reserved for VIPs and winners only, Riley will provide manifest and courier ETA windows: US HQ arrive by 8/12, APAC hub by 8/13.

CourierAI: Note: add customs description "Promo kit - documentation & accessories" and declared value $9.00. Use reference NG-8362 for labels.

Leah Morrison: Security note: do NOT include any model checkpoints on USB. USB should contain runbook, video fallback links (hosted), and a small script that fetches demo artifacts at runtime.

Arjun Singh: We'll include this fetch snippet in USB runbook:

```
# fetch demo artifact
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $SESSION_TOKEN" https://s3.redwood/internal-artifacts/nimbus-sample.tgz -o sample.tgz
```

Devon Park: Rehearsals: full run-through 8/13 10:00 PT, quick tech-check 8/15 09:00 PT. Need infra on-call for main broadcast and clinic switches. Arjun volunteer for clinic infra?

Arjun Singh: I'll be on-call for clinic infra for NA. Devon can cover EMEA. Priya cover APAC embed clinic.

Priya Mehta: I'll cover APAC. Also suggest adding a short rollback block in the runbook to play the clinic-specific fallback and update chat with "Playing fallback clip".

Riley (events): Registration question: do we permit shipping addresses from certain countries only? Some regions have compliance restrictions. Leah?

Leah Morrison: Limit physical shipments to NA, EU, and APAC major hubs (SG, JP, AU). For other regions, only digital swag. Riley list countries and I'll confirm.

CourierAI: Scheduled label creation for VIP kits 8/9, bulk kit pickup 8/11. Tracking posted once available.

Leah Morrison: Final owners: Devon (clinic tracks & backups), Arjun (edge clinic infra + fallback), Priya (embed clinic + assets), Riley (registration + swag + courier). I'll assemble partner runbook and do partner comms. Reconvene 8/9 for final checklist. Thanks :sparkles:
